trust_decision.summary: Whether an MCP caller-supplied filesystem destination (download save_dir, server-supplied download filename, save/load state path) may resolve outside the browse-mcp data roots; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: downloadUrl uses save_dir verbatim and resolveStatePath returns an explicit path verbatim. The fix also makes the raw-fetch download fallback honour the origin fence.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'unconfined download ... paths'; browser_download passes save_dir straight into downloadUrl, where `saveDir || DEFAULT_DIR` is used without checks.
